generated_response: Newton's third law states that for every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction. This means that if you push something, it will push back with the same force but in the opposite direction. For example, when you throw a ball, your arm exerts a force on the ball, which causes the ball to move forward. At the same time, the ball pushes back on your arm with an equal and opposite force, which stops the ball from falling backward.
